items.gloss_en: Last week the east pit lifted {T} baskets of copper ore. This week east pit workers lifted {A} baskets and west pit workers {B} baskets. By mine rule, whichever pit lags, for each basket of the gap (more-lifting pit minus less-lifting pit) the lagging pit's workers do {C} minutes of extra work. How many minutes of extra work in all must the lagging pit's workers do this week?
items.notes: Hyphens are compound joiners, not minus signs.
